summary.en-US: Crash-proof tab session backup and idle tab memory guardian for Firefox.

release_notes.en-US:
0.3.0

Added:
- UI localization: English, Russian, Kazakh, Ukrainian, Belarusian, Serbian (follows Firefox locale)

Fixed:
- Proper PNG toolbar/listing icons (vault-dial mark) instead of a generic puzzle placeholder
- Prefix text field styling on the dark settings page
- Release pipeline no longer false-fails while waiting for manual AMO review after a successful upload
